description: Python can create, write, read and remove a private temporary directory
command:
import os, pathlib, uuid
directory = pathlib.Path(os.environ['TMPDIR']) / ('private-probe-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)
os.mkdir(directory, 0o700)
file = directory / 'probe'
try:
    file.write_bytes(b'probe')
    assert file.read_bytes() == b'probe'
finally:
    if file.exists():
        file.unlink()
    directory.rmdir()
print('private temporary directory capability available')
